assertions_analysis.why_semantic_error_was_not_detected: Assertions checked surface consistency of raw values only: 'WPR2 MMIO LO=0x01f7e000', 'WPR2 MMIO HI=0x01ffee00', 'WPR2 size = 0x80E00', 'WPR2 matches dmesg pair'. Each is true in isolation because the raw register values, their raw difference, and the dmesg text all agree. No assertion applied the source field mapping (VAL[31:4] = 4 KiB address units -> byte decode) because assertions were written against raw MMIO values, not decoded byte addresses. Self-consistency among correct raw inputs cannot detect that the interpretation formula (raw subtraction vs field-extracted subtraction) is semantically wrong. A detecting assertion would be: decode(HI) - decode(LO) == 0x080E0000, or cross-check vs E16-007 base/end. This is a specification/semantics gap, not a data gap.
